    assertLineMatches(·, ·, ·, "CP applied the TxDefaultProfile")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"StopTransaction"/, "StopTransaction eventually sent")
    OR
    IF
      ·.fail("DB: transaction is closed (stop_timestamp set)", "no transaction found")
      RETURN
    assertNonEmpty(·, ·, "DB: transaction is closed (stop_timestamp set)")
  SPEC cert16-tc057-central-smart-charging-txprofile connector=1 bootWaitSecs=4 holdSecs=25
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"StartTransaction".*"idTag":"CERT057"/, "StartTransaction sent with idTag CERT057")
    assertResponseStatus(·, ·, "SetChargingProfile", "Accepted", "SetChargingProfile (TxProfile) accepted")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, ·, "CP applied the TxProfile")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"StopTransaction"/, "StopTransaction eventually sent")
    IF
      ·.fail("DB: transaction is closed (stop_timestamp set)", "no active transaction found for CERT057")
      RETURN
    assertNonEmpty(·, ·, "DB: transaction is closed (stop_timestamp set)")
  SPEC cert16-tc059-remote-start-with-profile connector=1 bootWaitSecs=4 holdSecs=40
    assertResponseStatus(·, ·, "RemoteStartTransaction", "Accepted", "RemoteStartTransaction (with attached TxProfile) accepted")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"StartTransaction"/, "StartTransaction sent")
    assertNoLineMatches(·, ·, ·, "attached profile is accepted but NOT stored/applied (Core CP may ignore SmartCharging profiles per OCPP 5.11)")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"StopTransaction"/, "StopTransaction eventually sent")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "StatusNotification")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "StartTransaction")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "Authorize")
    IF
      ·.fail("DB: transaction is closed (stop_timestamp set)", "no transaction found")
      RETURN
    assertNonEmpty(·, ·, "DB: transaction is closed (stop_timestamp set)")
  SPEC cert16-tc066-get-composite-schedule connector=1 bootWaitSecs=4 holdSecs=15
    assertResponseStatus(·, ·, "SetChargingProfile", "Accepted", "SetChargingProfile accepted")
    assertResponseStatus(·, ·, "GetCompositeSchedule", "Accepted", "GetCompositeSchedule accepted")
    assertCompositeSchedulePeriodLimit(·, ·, 11000, "returned schedule reflects the applied profile's period (limit 11000)")
  SPEC cert16-tc067-clear-charging-profile connector=1 bootWaitSecs=4 holdSecs=15
    assertResponseStatus(·, ·, "SetChargingProfile", "Accepted", "SetChargingProfile accepted")
    assertResponseStatus(·, ·, "ClearChargingProfile", "Accepted", "ClearChargingProfile accepted")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Cleared.*profile/, "CP logged clearing the stored profile")
